subject: Marketplace partner onboarding: SI rollout gating and entitlement waiver
messages:
From: Devon Myers <devon.myers@cloudway.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: cloudway-ps@cloudway.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox quota + SI rollout gating for CloudWay onboarding

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. To keep momentum on the POC with AcmePay we need two things aligned before our SI (CloudWay Professional Services) can start the integration sprint:

1) A temporary sandbox quota increase (from 10K tokens/day to 200K tokens/day) for the CloudWay sandbox project so the SI can run load and regression tests.
2) A short exception to the standard marketplace entitlement gating: our SI will exercise a private onboarding flow that requires a limited set of entitlement flags enabled for the partner account during the POC.

Attached is the updated SOW (cloudway_sow_v2.pdf) and an entitlement matrix showing the exact flags we need (entitlement_matrix.csv).

Can you confirm if Redwood can grant the quota and a scoped entitlement waiver for a 6-week POC? We need this by Friday to hit our integration window.

Best,
Devon
Devon Myers
Director, Cloud Partnerships, CloudWay

---
Attachment: cloudway_sow_v2.pdf (application/pdf)
Attachment: entitlement_matrix.csv (text/csv)
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Myers <devon.myers@cloudway.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 10:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox quota + SI rollout gating for CloudWay onboarding

Devon —

Thanks for the materials. Looping in Jonas from Marketplace Ops and Marcus from Runtime so we can triage the asks.

Quick notes:
- Sandbox quota: this is feasible as a short-term increase, but need to confirm the exact project id and whether tokens are counted against hosted or dedicated pools.
- Entitlement waiver: we can consider a scoped exemption, but need Product to approve which API capabilities can be toggled for the partner flow.

Jonas / Marcus — can you review the attached entitlement_matrix.csv and confirm feasibility and risk (security/abuse) by EOD Wednesday? If Product approval is required, Laura (cc'ed on follow-up) will need a one-paragraph business justification.

Kim

Kimberly Park
Partnerships Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox quota + SI rollout gating for CloudWay onboarding

Kim / team —

I've reviewed entitlement_matrix.csv and the SOW. Summary of technical impact:

- Sandbox quota increase: low risk. We can provision a temporary token bucket scoped to CloudWay-sandbox project. Need exact project id and expected peak RPS; assuming 200K tokens/day we should be fine for 6 weeks.

- Entitlement flags: two flags are problematic from a security perspective:
  * cross-tenant-kv-write: allows writing to KV namespaces that could be proxied for other tenants — not allowed even for POCs.
  * api-admin-metadata: exposes internal metadata APIs; we can only provide read-only variants.

Proposed compromise:
- Provide the quota increase.
- Offer a scoped waiver that enables only the non-sensitive entitlements for the SI flow.
- For the two risky flags, provide a simulated behavior layer (mock endpoints) and log all calls for review.

Marcus — can you validate operational cost delta for 200K tokens/day and sign off on telemetry plan? Once we have that, Laura can draft the product-level justification for the waiver.

- Jonas

Jonas Weber
Marketplace Ops Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox quota + SI rollout gating for CloudWay onboarding

Jonas / team —

Cost note: 200K tokens/day for 6 weeks is roughly ~8.4M tokens total. Estimated incremental cost on hosted pools ~ $1200 - $1500 (GPU / infra) depending on batching during tests. That's acceptable for a partner-led POC; recommend we bill to the partner's trial credit and monitor usage.

Telemetry/ops:
- We'll enable enhanced request logging for the sandbox project and a daily digest to the partnership owner.
- I'll set up a short retention window (30 days) for logs tied to the POC and ensure SOC2-safe storage.

Action item: Laura, can you draft the one-paragraph justification and requested duration (6 weeks) so I can trigger the quota change ticket? I can provision the token bucket once we have the formality.

Marcus

Marcus Lin
Runtime Product Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Myers <devon.myers@cloudway.com>, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox quota + SI rollout gating for CloudWay onboarding

Devon —

Thanks for the SOW and matrix. Business justification for the scoped entitlement waiver:

CloudWay is delivering an SI-led integration for a high-potential customer (AcmePay) that is expected to convert to a paid account if the POC completes. Granting a time-boxed (6-week) sandbox quota increase and a limited entitlement waiver will accelerate integration testing and reduce time-to-value for the buyer. All risky capabilities (cross-tenant writes, admin metadata) will be instrumented and simulated; no production entitlements will be granted. Redwood will monitor usage and reserve the right to revoke the waiver on anomalous behavior.

Requested duration: 6 weeks starting on the date of token bucket provisioning. Next steps:
- Marcus to open quota ticket and provision token bucket.
- Marcus to enable telemetry and daily digest.
- Jonas to coordinate mock endpoints for sensitive flags.
- Kimberly to confirm CloudWay project id and sign-off.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Product Partnerships
Redwood Inference
